value.main_text_excerpt:
Apache Solr & OpenSearch
Deep expertise in Apache Solr and OpenSearch — relevance tuning, scaling, cluster operations and search architecture, from someone who helps build the technology itself. The specialism Cominvent is known for.
Cominvent AS · Drammen, Norway
Cominvent is the independent practice of Jan Høydahl — Apache Lucene & Solr committer and Apache Software Foundation member, based in Drammen, Norway. Expert help with open-source search (Apache Solr & OpenSearch), plus AI & chatbots, open-source data platforms and cyber security.
What we do
LLM-powered applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search and conversational assistants — grounded in your own data.
Modern data platforms and lakehouse architectures on open-source foundations — ingestion, storage, query and governance without vendor lock-in.
Security assessments, infrastructure hardening and secure-by-design engineering for the search, data and AI systems you depend on.
Version migrations and upgrades, plus live production support for open-source search and data infrastructure when you need an expert on call.
Live, instructor-led online courses in Apache Solr and search — hands-on, and open to attendees anywhere. Run through our dedicated training business.
Browse courses at solrtraining.com →
Selected work
Replaced an aging legacy engine with Apache Solr — indexing cut from hours to minutes, better relevance and lower hardware cost.
Apache Solr search for Norway's largest electronic health-record platform — sub-second across millions of records, with facets, highlighting and ranking.
Site search across ~70 university web sites on Apache Solr and ManifoldCF, with custom crawling, security and facets.
Migrated news search from FAST to Apache Solr for eight online publications — cutting licence cost and easing cloud scaling.
Search behind the NAF travel planner (reiseplanlegger.naf.no).
Search and content matching for a privacy-first advertising platform that places ads by article content, without cross-site tracking.
About
Cominvent AS is the independent consulting practice of Jan Høydahl — based in Drammen, Norway, working with clients worldwide.
Jan has worked in IT since 1995, starting at Ericsson and then at search pioneer FAST Search & Transfer before going independent through Cominvent. For well over a decade he has been at the heart of open-source search: a member of the Apache Software Foundation, an Apache Lucene & Solr committer and PMC member, and a past Chair of the Apache Solr project — one of the people who build and steer the technology itself. His search work spans Apache Solr, Lucene, OpenSearch and Elasticsearch.
As a sole consultant, you work directly with Jan: no account managers, no hand-offs. Beyond search, Cominvent brings the same rigour to AI & chatbots, open-source data & lakehouse platforms and cyber security — designing, building and hardening the systems, and handing over the knowledge so your team can run them.
Apache Solr™ committer & PMC member · Apache Software Foundation member
Contact
Tell us about your project — search, AI, data or security — and we'll get back to you.
